_comment: A binge show: Hulu released the whole season at once (Nov 12 2026), so every episode has the same date. Use it in "Hide everything" mode; remove the show from the popup once finished. Dates cannot tell episodes apart, so ticking one episode does not uncover talk about earlier ones. Episode count: most sources say 8, a few say 10; check Hulu and add episodes 9 and 10 if they exist. accounts: no official X handle found yet; add it without the @ if one turns up. weak: cast members who are famous outside the show (podcasts, YouTube, the original Utah show); they only count with a context word, a second keyword, or on the drop night. 'Mormon Wives' also matches the original Utah show; over-blurring that is accepted. Then run npm test.
name: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
